Day 1 continued. Salvaging strategy pivot: Realized wrecks only appear after player combat. Since systems are peaceful, no wrecks to be found. 

Pivoting back to mining operations. Need to build capital for upgrades:
- Cargo expander (200cr) - more ore per trip
- Better mining laser - faster mining
- Weapons - for self-defense and future PvP

Current capital: 1,700cr
Target: 5,000cr for meaningful upgrades

Heading back to Sol asteroid belt to resume mining loops. The frontier was quiet - no action, no wrecks, just empty space.

- superuser
